## Environment

- Public source commit / locally built SYS SHA256:
- Windows build and architecture:
- Mac model and macOS version (no serial):
- Hardware ID without instance serial; composite parent or interface child:
- Cable type, ports and actual negotiated USB rate:
- Driver trust mode / Secure Boot / HVCI state:
- MTU on both ends; independent control link available:

## Reproduce

Steps, expected behavior, actual behavior and any bounded timeout. For transfers, state direction, payload size, timing scope, checksum result and whether traffic was confirmed to use USB.

## Redacted evidence

Include relevant error codes or a minimal synthetic fixture, not full device dumps, raw traces, crash dumps, credentials, serials, management addresses or private paths. Distinguish a failed transfer from a failed test-tool launch. State any retry, cable change or device reset explicitly.
